environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. Webhook payloads arrive from an API Gateway HTTP integration with no request validation template. Frontend is served via CloudFront with standard caching. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. Script tags rendered directly from Redis manifest without integrity attributes.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, internal ALB, API Gateway HTTP API (no request validation), CloudFront distribution with default cache behavior
